Chris heads to the bush to try to sort out an intriguing call for help. Schnitzel is a sixteen-month-old dachshund with a crazy obsession that's putting his life in danger. The determined dog has already been trodden on and suffered a broken toe, however, farmer Scott is sceptical about the vet's left-field solution.
Chris's trip has an unforgettable encounter with some of China's precious Giant Pandas. Chris is granted the rare privilege of hand feeding some youngsters.

Chris is confronted with an unusual patient, an albino echidna. But there's a question mark over whether the extremely rare echidna is a male or a female. It will have to be anesthetized so Chris can investigate.

Tiny Amari has been born with a badly twisted back leg. At just 3 days old she's one of the youngest kittens Chris has ever seen at the clinic. Amari needs a series of splints to try to save her leg, and give her a second chance.

Travel to the Cook Islands as Chris helps out at a vet clinic where ill and injured pets abound. Princess needs help following a hit and run, and Mani the duck has lost a fight. A goat and a wolfhound round out the medical menagerie.
Chris is spending 2 weeks volunteering at the busy Esther Honey vet clinic in the Cook Islands. This week his first patient is a much-loved cat called Small One, which has part of its nose missing.

Chris makes a special trip to Karara to see Stubby, a tiny 3-week-old piglet, born with only one trotter. Stubby is struggling to get around. If the brave little battler is to survive, Chris needs to work out a way for her to walk normally.

Alex and Gerardo team up to save a greedy groodle that swallowed a tube of glue, Brooke battles a large bone stuck deep inside a dog’s throat and a tiny kitten is rushed in after a play session with the family dog goes horribly wrong.

Rob treats a horrific lump growing behind dachshund Leos eye. Billy has a battle trying to find a snake that has been seen dangerously close to a family home. A Maltese Shih tzu is rushed to emergency with possible tick paralysis.

Rob performs surgery on a greyhound puppy with a badly fractured leg. The team at SASH has to fit 8-year-old cat, Bubby with a pacemaker. Ewan performs surgery on French bulldog Tyson, who is rushed to emergency with sudden paralysis.

Billy removes an object stuck down the throat of a giant alligator, but its not a job for the faint hearted. 13 year old French Bulldog Piglet faces a life and death battle. And a cat is badly injured after being hit by a car.

S4 E1FUEL TV takes you along as the crew embarks to the Caribbean and their first stop Puerto Rico, but before boarding the plane they experience one of the true joys of being a traveling surfer. Once they are airborne, find out a little bit about the crew and some of their talents both in and out of the water. Arriving in Puerto Rico the crew is greeted by local surfer Otto Flores who takes them to some of the more famous and lesser known surf spots. Greeted by a lot of wind the crew escapes to find a wavepool-like setup with one of the most rippable waves in the world.

S1 E8Shannon and Shayne explore the island of Taiwan and surf epic, typhoon-powered waves, check out the tallest building in the world, dance with native aborigines, and discover a hip and thriving surf culture.
S1 E9Shannon and Shayne go on a classic Baja surf adventure, and find that there is still plenty to explore and experience down this well traveled peninsula.

S3 E12Jeff King and the crew are given a Volvo from and with a little help from an old catamaran the Volvo becomes a Shredamaran.

p.t: The Standard Snowboard Show: Oh Canada
p.d: S3 E1Learn from some of the best snowboarders in Canada about what they like about riding and living in the great white north. Victoria Jealouse, Benji Ritchie, Brian Savard, Shin Campos and other Canadian riders show you some of their favorite locations to ride in Whistler B.C., McGillvery Pass and Bella Coola.  Canada is one the hottest places to go snowboarding and this show exposes some  of the best places to ride.

S3 E2For the first time ever Jeremy Jones, Jonas Emery and Jonaven Moore travel to Russia with Standard Films.  The crew snowboards and explores untracked and unmapped terrain by helicopter around Krasnaya Poliana in the Caucaus Mountains.<br /><br />Find out what it is like to snowboard in a third world country that seems to be living in the 1980's. Standard Films pioneers throughout Russia and reveals some of the best places to go ride in the world. <br />.

p.t: The Adventures of Danny and the Dingo: Viva La Chile
p.d: S5 E12Danny, the Dingo, and their snowboard crew spread the shred all the way to the Andes Mountains and celebrate Chile's independence at the Fonda.

p.t: The Adventures of Danny and the Dingo: Gettin' El Gaucho
p.d: S5 E13After participating in an Argentinian polo match, Danny, Dingo and the shred crew apply their newfound knowledge to the skate park and invent a new sport, Skate Polo.

p.t: Rayssa Leal - From Brazil To The World
p.d: This Monster Energy exclusive short film follows Rayssa Leal through her hometown of Imperatriz, Brazil where she gives us an inside scoop behind her passion for skateboarding. Filmed & edited by Marco Savino, with guest appearances by Monster Energy team riders Nyjah Huston, Giovanni Vianna, Filipe Mota, and more.

S1 E8From the moment her career took off, Rayssa Leal continues to crush records and complete huge milestones. In this video Rayssa returns to her Brazilian hometown and revisits spots and skateparks that molded her talents into the skater she has become.

S8 E4A Custom episode about Brazilian Olympic medalist, Rayssa Leal, one of today's biggest stars in skateboarding. Gaining attention after a video of her pulling a heel flip at the age of 7 was reposted by Tony Hawk, Rayssa has left her birth town in Brazil to conquer the world, having won two X-Games gold medals and two SLS World Championships.

S8 E5The second Monster Cash Up Jam in Cologne, Germany, is more like a street jam in a single spot. Here's the highlights thanks to Grant Castelluzzo. The Monster Cash Up is a series of five jams across the world with the common goal of having some fun and putting cash in people's hands while doing it.

The Ghost Hunters visit the historic Samuel Mudd House, famous for being a pit stop for John Wilkes Booth on his escape route following the assassination of Abraham Lincoln. Then, join TAPS as they investigate the Edgewood Plantation, part of the ancestral home of U.S. Presidents William Henry and Benjamin Harrison and site for the Confederate army during the Civil War.
While investigating one of the bloodiest battlefields in history, TAPS has a close encounter with Americas past

Josh Gates from Destination Truth joins the TAPS team as they embark on their next ghost hunting adventure - this time, in the haunted Essex County Jail. Are there souls still imprisoned in jail? Join the Ghost Hunters as they navigate through a dangerous labyrinth of rusty cells, deserted hallways and eerie underground tunnels to find the answer.

TAPS is joined by Dave Tango's father, Bruce Tango, to help the team investigate the Union County Courthouse in Elizabeth, New Jersey. Later, on the second investigation, TAPS investigates a 19th-century home in Hopkinton, New Hampshire.

The Church of St. Andrews in Staten Island NY is known as the friendliest church in the valley, yet recent paranormal activity has church staff spooked - are ghostly parishioners haunting the grounds? Then the Ghost Hunters head to the Windy City, where angry spirits have allegedly taken control of a local community center in South Chicago.

Musical legend Meat Loaf joins the team for an exciting investigation of Syfy's Great American Ghost Hunt winner Danielle Parody's estate. The private island has been in Danielle's family for over 50 years and since that time many have made claims about paranormal encounters in and around the property.
TAPS heads to Quincy, Massachusetts to investigate the unexplainable paranormal events that are haunting a 716 foot long ship.
TAPS is called in to investigate the Fort Henry, where it once served as a cornerstone for Canada's military defense and execution site.

The team returns to Chicago to investigate the historic Congress Theater. Since it was established in 1925, infamous acts like Prince and Billy Idol have graced the stage. Yet recently, the most popular shows appear to be the ones that go on behind the scenes when the paranormals come out to play.

TAPS heads to Colorado to investigate the manor where the walls are bleeding. Briarhurst Manor was originally built in 1888 and is 14,000 square feet of pure eeriness. This swank (and spooky) property was a finalist in Syfy's Great American Ghost Hunt contest. America voted and thinks the place is haunted, so the team heads in to investigate.

TAPS investigates the Buffalo Bill museum with guest hunter Eddie McClintock from the hit Syfy series Warehouse 13. According to various workers, the museum is filled with unexplained activity that appears paranormal; so the Ghost Hunters head in to investigate.

The team travels to Fitzwilliam, New Hampshire to investigate the Amos J. Blake House Museum. Then they head to the Arbona Building in Pensacola, Florida where books fall off shelves perfectly stacked.
TAPS heads to the Florida Panhandle to investigate a notoriously haunted lighthouse with over a century's worth of paranormal reports.
TAPS is called to the former home of one of the world's most famous authors in order to investigate a series of startling paranormal occurrences.

TAPS heads to Willow Grove, Pennsylvania to investigate an 18th-century farmhouse, where it has been claimed to be inhabited by spirits that allegedly play with the lights and cast large, dark shadows. Later, on the second investigation of the episode, TAPS heads to Hartford, Connecticut to the Old State House. Where it has been claimed to have disembodied voices and phantom footfalls.

Ironically, in this era of Social Media, people are feeling more isolated and disconnected than ever. Groups like the team at ‘Be That’ are looking to change this, encouraging Australians to connect face to face and begin real conversations. ‘Be That’ has assembled a crew of Clinical Psychologists to develop relevant resources to encourage people to gather together and connect through intentional and empowering conversations. The Be That TV Show, created in partnership with ACCTV, shares the real stories of individuals, couples and families who have journeyed through bondage to freedom and inspire others that they too can overcome challenges. Topics are discussed with host Jo Bouris, and regular panellist, Clinical Psychologist, Sarah Harriott. Guests are welcomed to the couch, who speak hope, life and encouragement through their personal experience. Viewers can then access the topic resources and corresponding questions to start their own journey to understanding and healing: ‘Be that

What does a Viking and wireless technology have in common? - Unity. In this episode we discover the man who inspired the name of Bluetooth technology and how he connected his nation and brought Christianity to Scandinavia.

Ming Wang is an impoverished Chinese prodigy who flees Communist China to become a pioneering eye surgeon in America. When tasked with restoring the sight of an orphan in India, who was blinded by her stepmother, Wang must confront the trauma of living through the violent uprising in his youth, the Cultural Revolution.

Hilarious, family-friendly comedians present a night of clean, feel-good laughter. Featuring top talent who prove you don’t need crude jokes to be funny, this series delivers quick wit, clever humour, and plenty of joy.

Pastor Joseph Prince preaches dynamic messages centred on the pure gospel of the grace of God. His desire is to help believers understand grace and how greatly blessed, highly favoured and deeply loved they are by their heavenly Father.

The best-known Christian evangelist of the 20th century, Billy Graham gained world attention in 1949 with a tent revival in downtown Los Angeles that was scheduled for three weeks and lasted six. In the ensuing 55 years and more, 'Billy Graham Crusades' consistently drew audiences of thousands to arenas and stadiums throughout the world.'Classic Crusades' presents the best of the last 35 years of Billy Graham that brought the message of salvation through Jesus Christ to the world. World renowned actors, singers, athletes and ministers share the platform with Dr. Graham. Also often features the famous sounds of the Billy Graham Choir, George Beverly Shea and Cliff Barrows for an hour of blessing and inspiration to all who watch.
Join Pastor Steven in the Basin where he digs deep into scripture and breaks down the Word of God in these short conversational teachings.
It’s God’s deep love for us that sustains us through our trials. Today, Joyce shares encouraging insights from her book Unshakeable Trust.

This is the record of a road trip with a difference – taking a Harley where it was never designed to go. Country music artist Steve Grace had a dream of riding his motorbike from Byron Bay to the Birdsville Hotel in remote Outback Queensland, along the way telling the stories of the hardworking people he encountered.

God not only promises peace—He shows you how to keep it. In this message from his series Lessons from Philippians, Pastor Bayless reveals how your thought life determines whether peace remains or fades. You’ll discover why meditating on what is true, noble, and pure protects your heart, and you’ll learn the secret of being content whether facing need or abundance. When your trust is anchored in God, you can live independent of circumstances. Don’t miss this encouraging message that will help steady your heart.

p.t: Turning Point With Dr. David Jeremiah
p.d: Continue to focus your mind on heaven through meaningful worship with musical guests Michael Sanchez, Jordan Smith, and others.

Bruce Downes is The Catholic Guy. Bruce and his team will move, inspire and challenge you to live your life to the absolute fullest. No matter your age, situation or background, be prepared to laugh, learn and listen to what God is trying to say to you. Bruce travels Australia speaking regularly about his experiences in life and in the Church in a way that is both relatable and easy to understand. Bruce's message of power, impact, freedom and purpose is for anyone and everyone - for no matter where you are around the world today, God is never far from you.
The Living Waters team takes the gospel to London during the Coronation of King Charles.

Chef Dev shares recipes for some of his favorite street food desserts from around the world, including Custard Tarts from Portugal, Alfajores Sandwich Cookies from Argentina, and Purple Corn Pudding from Peru.

Chef-host Shahir Massoud cooks from the award-winning cookbook Chinese-ish by Joanna Hu and Rosheen Kaul, whipping up billionaire-worthy fried rice, Aussie-inspired shrimp toast, comforting chicken soup and more.

Chef-host Shahir Massoud explores the award-winning cookbook Pasta Every Day by Meryl Feinstein, demonstrating how to make fresh pasta shapes including cavatelli, farfalle and gnocchi, all paired with delicious sauces.
Chef Michael Bonacini explores the diversity of the Italian region Calabria by making fresh tuna to hearty pork to a sumptuous orange cake.
The Italian region Campania is known for its seafood and pizza. Famed Chef Michael Bonacini prepares classics like Margherita Pizza and Fried Seafood.
Rice Balls Stuffed with Seafood and Pistachio Cannoli are on the menu as Chef Michael Bonacini explores dishes from the Italian island of Sicily.
Piemonte cuisine is influenced by its mountainous terrain. Chef Michael Bonacini shows us how to make its warm regional dishes like Bagna Cauda.

Bustling markets and sizzling sounds inspire a griddled tour of street food. From sweet to savory, each dish captures the rhythm of streets worldwide reflecting the traditions and bold character of flavors everywhere.

Maddie and Kiki are serving up a BBQ menu packed with bold spices, sweet flavours, and creative combinations. They sear blackened scallops with avocado corn relish, glaze duck wings with raspberry chipotle sauce, pair them with smashed potatoes and mushrooms, and cool down with honeyed watermelon salad and a rum cooler.

Maddie and Kiki are taking BBQ comfort food to the next level with smoky favourites and sweet surprises. They grill Brussels sprouts with pancetta, truffle, and parmesan, smoke hickory turkey legs with a sweet and spicy black bean salad, and finish with grilled fruit treats.
Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini shows takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

Desiree Nielsen makes a tonic of oranges, carrots, pomegranates and mint from her garden, then she serves sweet potato hash with edamame and bok choy, next she combines warm grilled romaine with nutty barley and crispy halloumi to create a main dish.

Experience corrections officer Alex’s encounter with the dark energy of a deceased prisoner seemingly bent on revenge. Probe a puzzling case with EMT Cory, whose patient seemed normal but died after an evil shadow rampaged through his room.
Deborah is disturbed when her critically injured boyfriend tries to break into the morgue. Plus, paranormal activity hits the dialysis clinic.
Big scares come in small packages—a ghostly girl follows a care-home housekeeper, disembodied footsteps trail a hospital balloon, and a pint-sized angel of death appears.

Both Ruth and Penny share their homes with ghosts who never left them.

Gaye and her sister summon the dead; Marina Duarte is plagued by paranormal activity after a spirit board session; Lisa discovers that not all the ghosts haunting her childhood home are evil.
A woman buys a haunted farmhouse, and a couple's new home seeps blood.

Chefs compete for a top job at Araxi in Whistler, BC. A blind taste test sends winners to a dining-in-the-dark experience in Santa Monica. With tensions rising at elimination, who will Gordon send home?
Gordon Ramsay's cookery competition goes French. Contestants make crepes then tackle traditional ingredients, including frogs' legs. Can anyone impress Chef Ramsay at dinner service?

Teams must create three dishes from 15 ingredients before Ramsay's flight lands back in LA from Whistler, BC. At dinner service, he throws a curve ball: the contestants must design a new menu from scratch. How will they cope?

The remaining chefs merge into one team and try to recreate one of Ramsay's signature dishes. The closest match wins a meal cooked by season four champ Christina Machamer. Tensions flare at dinner service. Who goes home?
Contestants create an entree for Ramsay and Bon Appetit magazine staff. Winners get featured in the mag, while losers pick up roadside rubbish. After another poor dinner service, who goes home?

Only four chefs remain and the pressure's on. Gordon challenges them to cook vegetarian dishes for 80 guests, only to reveal they're kids who hate veg. After a solid evening service, who gets sent home?

The final three tackle Chinese, Indian and Mexican dishes, judged by cuisine experts. The winner enjoys a meal cooked by the judges, while losers polish silver. Evening service tests their leadership. Can they impress Ramsay?

In the grand final, the last two chefs must create a dish worthy of Araxi restaurant. With eliminated contestants returning to help, they serve their own menus to impress exec chef James Walt. Who takes the crown?
The 16 chefs prepare their signature dishes in the season's first challenge; a contestant is rushed to the emergency room; guests begin to leave when the dinner service is delayed; an elimination.
Teams tackle sushi, but it proves too much for some. Winners enjoy a wine tasting, losers are stuck on prep. One team's dinner service is disaster after disaster. Who gets eliminated?
The thirteen contestants must prepare breakfast for fifty hungry EMTs. The winning team enjoy a poolside lunch and a trip to trapeze school while the losers are on cleaning duty.

The chefs created their own ravioli including pasta, filling and sauce. After judging by Ramsay, the winning team took a helicopter trip to a coastal resort to play golf, and the losing team cleaned the kitchens and milked cows.

The chefs prepare a tasting menu of an appetizer and two main dishes for the Beverly Hills High School prom committee; the women visit Knott's Berry Farm and the men cleaned the kitchens and helped the prom committee put up decorations.

Chef Ramsay moves some of the team members around before the new groups are challenged to come up with a special salad dish, with the best meal being featured in a magazine; at evening service, things start badly and then get worse.

p.t: Hedgerow Hell: The Fury of Normandy - 1944
p.d: In July of 1944, at the height of World War II in Europe, Americans stormed the beaches of Normandy. Everyone thought it would be a relatively easy move into enemy territory and past Adolph Hitler's Nazi forces. They were wrong. It took nearly two months to advance only 50 kilometers into the French countryside. Now, commanders and historians study the events of Normandy to improve modern tactics.

For four years, the Swastika flag flew over Paris in a time of deprivation, humiliation, and repression. Despite Hitler’s vow to destroy Paris rather than surrender it, Parisians rose up to play a crucial role in driving the Nazis out.

This infamous battle was one of the worst moments of World War II. On one August evening, after 9 hours of fighting, over 2,000 mostly Canadian Allied soldiers were killed in a raid on a Nazi-occupied port.

For the first time the story of the Katyn massacre is seen from both sides: that of the victims and that of the perpetrators. It reveals how this crime, attributed to the Nazis for 50 years, was in fact carried out by the Soviet secret police, the NKVD.

Buzz around the rehab centre as Hope and her team prep it for an open house, and see how a release near the birthplace of hockey goes offside. Meanwhile, a deer who has recuperated decides not to go home after all.

Check out Emma’s adorable orphaned patient before a moment of madness puts Archie’s future in jeopardy. Examine a German shepherd who is losing her mobility, then encounter some special babies at a wildlife sanctuary with Dr. Scott.
Noelle and Luke have been living in an apartment, but with three children, it was time for a house with a backyard and… a dog to play in that backyard! Can Dr. Lisa Chimes find them the perfect dog?

Single mum Jenny and her three kids live in a rented house with a big backyard, and son Harrison wants a dog. The backyard is in need of repair, and the family can’t decide on what sort of dog to get. Can they all agree on one dog?

Jo is a single mum with two little girls; she’d like a dog as part of their family. Jo loves running and would love a dog that can join her, but having two small girls, a smaller dog might be better. Can Dr. Lisa find the right dog?

Discover the secrets to dogproofing a home as Dr. Lisa helps the Formosas welcome a new bestie for their daughter, Roxy. Watch them narrow down the little one’s list of must-haves before they head to the pound to meet some contenders.

Barry and Hayley's adventure in the United Kingdom continues to take place at a rehabilitation centre, where they utilise the latest in alternative therapies; Hope for Wildlife begins expanding further than Hope's small farm.
Chris's trip has an unforgettable encounter with some of China's precious Giant Pandas. Chris is granted the rare privilege of hand feeding some youngsters.

Follow neurologist Dr. James into the exam room to check on Alien, a kitty who has healed beautifully after a bizarre injury. Then head to cardiology with Dr. Williams, who’s determined to solve the mystery of cat Chloe’s irregular breathing.
A tiny Chihuahua undergoes a challenging hip replacement surgery; a chaotic cat invades the clinic and a pet gets an extreme makeover.

On this blisteringly cold episode of Mythbusters, the team gets some northern exposure as they pack up their sleds, their brass monkeys and their ingenuity for Alaska Special, The Return.
In this hang-on-for-dear-life episode of MythBusters, there’s thrills, spills and a blast from the criminal past. So strap in, because this is going be one heck of a wild ride.
Button up your bullet-proof vest and gear up your ears because on this episode of Mythbusters there are guns galore and sonic booms aplenty!

On this elemental MythBusters episode featuring fire, ice, and heavy metal, Adam and Jamie test a viral internet video in Thermite Vs Ice—pitting a nearly 2000-degree burning chemical against frozen water.

Business as usual—scientific genius and explosive action! Adam and Jamie test the classic physics theory: if you fire a bullet and drop one from the same height, do they hit the ground at the same time?

Adam and Jamie revisit their first ever duct tape episode—discussing, dissecting and delighting in the classic. Features never-before-seen footage, viewer QAndA and behind-the-scenes insights from the legends.
Adam and Jamie test whether leaving windows open during a hurricane reduces damage, using NASA data and the world's largest portable hurricane simulator at the University of Florida.

On this episode of Mythbusters, the team dives into hells kitchen to test two frightening potential kitchen catastrophes with a quirky look at myth that might be on the nose: can cheese be used as canon fodder?
On this episode of MythBusters, it’s an evolution revolution as the team takes five fan favourites and focuses on a fascinating new facet for each.
On this episode buckle up cos it’s going to be a bumpy ride. Adam and Jamie get down and dirty with the myth that a muddy motorcar gets better mileage than it’s clean cousin.
Thrills and spills in this MythBusters classic. Adam and Jamie test a Hollywood staple since the motorcar was invented: two cars in a high-speed chase deep in the countryside.
On this easily digestible episode of MythBusters, we’re testing two myths- suggested by the fans- that push the limits of what people are willing to try, and what they simply can’t avoid.

On this episode of Mythbusters it’s Mini Myth Mayhem as the team fire off 6 quick fire fan requested fables. First up Adam and Jamie post a coconut. Yup viewers have heard that it’s possible to sed a coconut with an engraved address through the mail.

First up Adam and Jamie jump in with Dumpster Diving. It’s a well worn action movie cliché - after a roof top chase, the hero is cornered with nowhere else to go. But luckily there’s a convenient dumpster on the street below. So he takes the dive, lands safely, dusts himself off and makes his escape. But is a trash landing really a guaranteed getaway or is this just another example of Hollywood hype?
On this felonious episode of Mythbusters, we tackle two highly dangerous tales from the wrong side of the tracks.
Head to Indonesia, where the toxic air in some regions is 40 times above safety levels. Elsewhere, small volcanoes are so active they erupt every 15 minutes.

Survival in the forest means maintaining a delicate balance between growth and destruction and death and rebirth - a forest should be in a constant state of regeneration. When trees get too tall they block all the sunlight from hitting the ground, which means grasses and smaller shrubs can’t grow, diminishing habitat for animals like elk, moose, caribou, and wolves.

A close look is taken at the Rocky Mountains to reveal how many animals rely on social groups to increase their chances of survival among the harsh elements, even as no two animal groups structure their group living norms in the same way.
At the southern edge of the Pantanal, the world's largest tropical wetland on Earth, there's a place like no other, and a wildlife so diverse scientists scramble to understand it.
The Pantanal is the largest tropical wetland on Earth, yet it's also one of the most unforgiving habitats to call home.

Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. This tree is never lonely, learn how it provides food, shelter and a hunting ground to many creatures.
This is the story of the much-loved sausage tree, a beguiling plant which attracts huge numbers of birds, while enduring harsh conditions in the dry season.

p.t: Mama Twiga in the Garden of Eden
p.d: Mama Twiga in the Garden of Eden tells the emotional story of a mother giraffe, Mama Twiga, and the struggles of young giraffes and gazelles as they take on the risks of growing in the wilds of Swahili.
Two fawns, one an impala and the other a Thompson’s gazelle, must outrun predators to survive in the East African savannah, a stunning yet perilous place where survival is a relentless battle.
The source of the Mekong River is high up in the Tibetan plateau, from there it flows into Yunnan Province, China, where our journey begins.
This is a country of outstanding natural beauty and the Mekong carves out pockets of ancient forest that provide refuge for some of the most beautiful and elusive creatures on Earth.

Kenya’s making a massive move towards setting up the country's first community-run rhino sanctuary. Find out why Lewa reckons it's the right call, and watch the teams as they shift rhinos from all over the shop to this new conservancy.

Invasive species are closely examined, including starlings who were introduced to New York City's Central Park in 1890, to demonstrate the impact that these birds and other invasive species have had on North American habitats.
